translatedContent:
Close to the subway station, but the room was small and the facilities were old.

Arrived around 2 PM. Hotel service was mediocre; none of the staff greeted guests. The walk to the west wing was quite long, but the front desk staff responded quickly.

The room wasn't clean; there were cigarette butts left by the previous guest.

The toilet had a strong sewer smell, and the door wouldn't close properly, leaving a large gap.

The hotel toiletries were all sample sizes, insufficient. The shower water pressure was very low.

The soundproofing was extremely poor.

The Wi-Fi in the west wing rooms was very difficult to connect to; when we called the front desk, they told us to connect in the hallway.

The mattress was high and hard, and the room was dim even with all the lights on.

feedbackContent: Dear guest, it is delightful to hear your affirmation of our hotel services. I will definitely share your opinion with our team, especially your recognition of our staff's service. translatedContent: This is my second time staying at this hotel for a trip to Beijing, and the experience is still great. The hotel is located in a prime area, within walking distance of popular attractions like Wangfujing Street, the Forbidden City, and Tiananmen Square. Public transportation, subway, and taxis are also very convenient for getting around. The executive lounge features 180° floor-to-ceiling windows, offering stunning views of city landmarks such as the Forbidden City, Beihai Park, and Jingshan Park while you enjoy delicious food. The hotel also offers intangible cultural heritage experiences. On my check-out day, the service staff proactively asked if I needed luggage assistance, which was a very thoughtful and heartwarming gesture. Highly recommended!
feedbackContent: 尊敬的賓客 非常感謝您長期以來對我們的一貫關照！聽到您對我們工作的肯定，十分開心。 我會將您的意見與我們的團隊一起分享，特別是您對於我們服務的認可和讚賞。一直以來，我們堅持不懈地提升服務質量，我相信這個反饋將給我們所有的員工帶來莫大的鼓舞。 北京和平賓館位於北京市中心，步行可至王府井商業圈、故宮、天安門等商業購物中心及主要旅遊景點，地理位置非常優越，交通便利。 再次感謝您與我們分享您的體驗，我們真誠地希望您的下一次光臨會像前一次一樣愉快。 酒店賓客關係經理 北京和平賓館的問候！
feedbackTranslateContent: Dear Guest, Thank you so much for your continued patronage! We are delighted to hear your positive feedback on our work. content:
房間總體來説還不錯，空調製冷效果很好👍。不過浴室淋浴間有點小問題——水總是往外漏，地漏還有反味，雖然阿姨很熱心地過來噴了好幾次空氣清新劑，服務態度值得肯定，但這種硬件設施確實該好好維修一下了。

游泳池偏小，不過帶娃玩玩也夠用了。

另外，手工非遺體驗必須給五星好評！🌟
translatedContent:
Overall, the room was pretty good, and the air conditioning worked perfectly. However, the shower in the bathroom had a bit of an issue – water kept leaking out, and there was a bad smell coming from the floor drain. Although the cleaning lady was very kind and came to spray air freshener multiple times, which we appreciated her service attitude, the hardware facilities really need some proper maintenance.

The swimming pool was a bit small, but it was sufficient for playing with the kids.

On a different note, the intangible cultural heritage handicraft experience deserves a five-star rating! 🌟

feedbackTranslateContent: Dear Guest, Thank you for your feedback and positive review of your stay. We are pleased to hear that the room's air conditioning worked well, and that our staff's attentive service after the bathroom issues were a pleasant surprise. We sincerely apologize for the shortcomings in the bathroom facilities you mentioned, such as the small shower space, water overflow, and odor from the drain. We have noted these issues and will incorporate them into our renovation and maintenance plan to improve the guest experience. We also highly value the enjoyment brought by the traditional handicraft experience, which many guests have appreciated. We will continue to upgrade the courses and related services. We sincerely hope to welcome you back after the hotel's upgrades are completed, so you can experience our improvements and dedication firsthand. Customer Relations Manager, Beijing Peace Hotel

content: Очень плохо убираются в номере. Нет возможности повлиять на администратора когда пьяные жильцы отеля мешают спать. Этаж был для некурящих, однако всем плевать на запреты. Администрации никак не реагируют на нарушения. Китайцы курят и в номерах и в туалетах в бассейне, но никому до этого нет дела
translatedContent: The room cleaning is extremely poor. There's no way to influence the manager when drunken hotel guests are disturbing your sleep. The floor was non-smoking, but no one cares. The management doesn't respond to violations. Chinese people smoke in their rooms and in the restrooms at the pool, but no one cares.
feedbackContent: Dear Guest, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and disappointment you experienced during your stay. Regarding the disturbances caused by noisy guests at night and smoking in non-smoking areas, we have increased security patrols on affected floors and strictly enforced no-smoking policies across all zones, promptly addressing any violations. Management will continue to monitor corrective actions and ensure accountability to prevent similar incidents from recurring. If you would be willing to give us another opportunity to serve you in the future, we pledge to do our utmost to provide a fresh, clean room that meets your expectations.Guest Relations Manager at Peace Hotel Beijing

feedbackTranslateContent: Dear Guest, we are very sorry that the odor from the sewer in the early morning disturbed your rest and significantly reduced your experience. We are deeply sorry. Guest Relations Manager, Beijing Peace Hotel

feedbackContent: Dear guest,Thank you very much for your feedback.We are glad that you appreciated our hotel’s great location.We sincerely apologise that the extra bed was not comfortable enough during your stay. content: This is my second time staying at Peace Hotel, first time was in 2017. This time we stayed at the newer West Wing. We initially had only planned to stay one night but decided to extend our stay and stayed 5 nights this visit. The hotel gave us a voucher for complimentary art workshop. I thoroughly enjoyed the experience and so did my nieces. Location of the hotel is perfect, within walking distance to few subway stations and just one block away from downtown commercial shopping. Staff are friendly, great breakfast selection, rooms are, clean and spacious. The housekeeping staff are very polite and friendly,  they are constantly maintaining the cleanliness and tidyness of the space. We did not get a chance to use the pool, as the day goes by it gets pretty busy with kids, swimming cap is mandatory and can be purchased from the gym trainers. The laundry room was convenient (3 washer, 3 dryer), detergent supplied, but the dryer takes a long time to fully dry so we ended up airing our clothes in our suite. If I return to Beijing again in the future, I will definitely book this hotel again.
feedbackContent: Dear guests, we sincerely appreciate your high praise for our hotel! It is our great honor to provide you with warm service and a comfortable stay, which has always been our unremitting pursuit. Beijing Peace Hotel is located in the heart of Beijing. It is within walking distance to commercial shopping centers and major tourist attractions such as Wangfujing Business District, the Forbidden City, and Tiananmen Square. The hotel enjoys a prime location and convenient transportation. Once again, we are grateful for your valuable feedback and recommendation. We will continue to strive to offer every guest better service and a more comfortable accommodation environment. We look forward to your and your family's return! Greetings from the Guest Relations Manager of Beijing Peace Hotel.

content: Расположение отеля отличное, рядом 2 линии метро, с которых очень удобно добираться до всех достопримечательностей. Сам отель немного устарел. Есть несвежий запах в номерах. Местоположение отеля просто огонь-огонь! Центр Ванфуцина! На такси можно добраться хоть куда и недорого. 
В общем, от пребывания в отеле Peace Hotel осталось только приятное впечатление!
